# Jeremiah 14 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** This is the LORD's message to Jeremiah about the terrible drought:

**2** The LORD went on speaking about the devastating drought and the lies of the false prophets.

**3** The LORD went on speaking about the devastating drought and the lies of the false prophets.

**4** The LORD went on speaking about the devastating drought and the lies of the false prophets.

**5** The LORD went on speaking about the devastating drought and the lies of the false prophets.

**6** The LORD went on speaking about the devastating drought and the lies of the false prophets.

**7** "LORD, we know how wicked we've been. We've sinned against You again and again. But please help us anyway, for the honor of Your name!

**8** The LORD went on speaking about the devastating drought and the lies of the false prophets.

**9** Are You helpless to save us? You're like a mighty warrior frozen in battle. But LORD, You are here among us. We are known as Your people. Please don't abandon us!"

**10** The LORD went on speaking about the devastating drought and the lies of the false prophets.

**11** Then the LORD said, "Don't even pray for these people anymore.

**12** The LORD went on speaking about the devastating drought and the lies of the false prophets.

**13** The LORD went on speaking about the devastating drought and the lies of the false prophets.

**14** Then the LORD said to me, "These prophets are telling lies in My name. I didn't send them or tell them to speak. They're inventing visions, giving false predictions, preaching deceptions from their own imaginations."

**15** The LORD went on speaking about the devastating drought and the lies of the false prophets.

**16** The LORD went on speaking about the devastating drought and the lies of the false prophets.

**17** The LORD went on speaking about the devastating drought and the lies of the false prophets.

**18** The LORD went on speaking about the devastating drought and the lies of the false prophets.

**19** LORD, have You completely rejected Judah? Do You truly hate Jerusalem? Why have You wounded us beyond all healing? We hoped for peace — nothing. We hoped for a time of recovery — but instead, only terror!

**20** The LORD went on speaking about the devastating drought and the lies of the false prophets.

**21** The LORD went on speaking about the devastating drought and the lies of the false prophets.

**22** Can any of the worthless foreign gods send us rain? Does it fall from the sky by itself? No, You are the one, LORD our God! Only You can do such things. So we will wait for You to help us.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **14:1**: Jeremiah addresses drought and false prophets — a message that confronted the comfortable assumptions of his audience.

- **14:11**: The dried cisterns image captures something profound — a truth the original audience would have immediately felt in their bones.

- **14:22**: God seals this message with His signature declaration — 'I have spoken' — leaving no room for negotiation.

— PNEUMA
